remake_characters.note: Remake player-role definition; similar to Chara0/anon but no independently supported source-ID mapping. Not Chara2.

reproducibility.line_numbers: 1-based physical source lines, including comments and blank lines; comments are not parsed as definitions
reproducibility.allowlist: extraction_python is the exact read-only extraction used; no images or dialogue included
reproducibility.stable_order: source rows sorted by numeric source_id; source paths unique ignoring case; remake rows retain JSON order
reproducibility.rerun: Execute extraction_python from this JSON with Python 3. Compare source_characters, remake_characters, and input_manifest; findings are human static-review conclusions, not automatically recertified.

age_reference_scan.limitation: Identifier scan supports inspected boundaries; it does not prove universal absence of alternate-named checks or certify runtime behavior.

findings.summary: Source Surei (remake slay) has apparent age 13; Maria has apparent age 15. Both are blocked from adult presentation. Their confirmed chronological ages remain unknown, not 13/15 asserted as chronology.

All source definitions provide apparent age only. Chara200 comment explicitly says actual age is not implemented. Apparent age >=18 is not adulthood evidence or visual clearance. Ayaka has a schoolgirl context marker; Maria also has a youthful-face marker.

Remake character JSON and CharacterDefinition do not retain a source age or confirmed-age/review status. Missing age cannot be interpreted as adult. Default ApparentAge values in save models do not establish adulthood.
Generation pool includes apparent ages 12, 14 and 16. The weighted selector can return all three; generated recruit creation stores the result without an adult eligibility gate.
Player age picker exposes the entire apparent-age pool and passes selection to ModifyPlayer, which applies the callback without validation. Player is in scope, not exempt.

Registry validation checks items/missions/enemies rather than character age; save loading deserializes and migrates, then checks schema. Migration normalizes state without age or design review. Malformed/legacy/custom age data have no inspected adult eligibility rejection boundary.

Inspected mature-action entry point checks character existence, daily capacity, energy, bond, condition, consent and tools, but not adult eligibility. Those checks are not substitutes for adulthood. Inspected visual wrapper chooses layered or fallback portraits without adult review status.

rancher resembles the player-role archetype but has no supported independent numeric CSV mapping. Chara2 and Chara200 are not mapped to remake definitions. Neither omission nor player-role similarity supplies adult clearance.

generator_static_verification.method: Exhaustive Python replay of each integer roll in Random.Next(sum(weights)); not execution of C# or rendering
generator_static_verification.note: Code comment says percentages, but these are relative weights totaling 90, not 100.

required_policy.decision: BLOCK adult presentation for minors, minor-apparent-age designs, unknown/ambiguous age or design, and unreviewed assets. All catalog entries remain uncleared.
required_policy.numeric_relabeling: Changing age to 18+ or relying on supernatural chronology is not sufficient to clear a minor-coded or ambiguous design.
author_decisions_needed: Document actual adult identity with provenance separately from apparent age.
Resolve school-age context and other ambiguity through an authorized eligibility decision; exclude blocked characters from adult presentation.
Record independent, non-explicit design review and asset-specific approval before any adult use.
Choose safe non-adult handling for missing, conflicting, legacy or unreviewed data.
required_boundaries: CSV/JSON import and fallback seed validation
generated recruits, rerolls, capture/preferences and archetype selection
required_policy.visual_certification: None; no art generated, modified or reviewed.
